title: nexu-io/open-design
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product in the form of a local-first design application that can be monetized.

zh.gap: 给不会设计的人做设计工具，胜负仍取决于谁把代理包装得最好——但这个项目自己正在高速填补这个缺口：390 个贡献者外加自营付费 Cloud。
zh.pain: 不会设计但想要真交付物（落地页、幻灯片、PDF）的普通人，不想再从聊天框里复制代码片段——三个月 8.2 万星、9500 fork 说明拉力巨大。
zh.kill: 你打不过一个有 390 名贡献者、有核心团队和自有变现的项目；任何'轻量克隆'起跑就落后三个月，对面每月还推 515 个提交。
zh.move: 不正面打。开放的侧翼是垂直化：锁定一类人群（教师、房产中介、婚礼策划），配模板、托管、零密钥配置——这些正是横向开源工具刻意不做的部分。

gap: Design tooling for people who can't design is still won by whoever packages agents best — but this project itself is filling that gap at speed, with 390 contributors and its own paid Cloud tier.
pain: Non-designers who want real deliverables (landing pages, decks, PDFs) out of their coding agent instead of chat snippets — 82k stars and 9.5k forks in three months say the pull is enormous.
kill: You cannot out-build a 390-contributor project with a funded core team and its own monetization; any 'lite' clone starts three months behind an org shipping 515 commits a month.
move: Not head-on. The open flank is vertical: one audience (e.g. teachers, real-estate agents, wedding planners) with templates, hosting and zero BYOK setup — the parts a horizontal open-source tool deliberately leaves out.
demoted_why: zero first-hand voices, and the card's own kill says you cannot beat a 390-contributor project — that is an archive, not a front-page build
